range_and_held_attack_boundaries.actual_contract: CustomRangeAttack squares configured min/max radii. Start check requires target memory and no special cooldown, optional sight and inclusive squared min/max range. Delayed action requires nonnull target, sight unconditionally and max range; successful invocation sets special attack cooldown to configured interval. Minimum range is not rechecked at delayed action. CustomHeldAttack requires target, squares ranges, checks optional sight/inclusive range on start, and its tick calls inherited tick(owner), applies callback with runningTime, stops and sets special cooldown when callback returns false, then increments runningTime. SBL lifecycle/delay/memory implementation and exact installed pin remain outside this selected boundary; no fixed attack-frequency guarantee follows.

effect_source_and_predicate_removal.actual_contract: TensuraMobEffect.addEffect preserves source UUID and ability/mode metadata, then calls native LivingEntity.addEffect. UUID overload supplies getPlayerByUUID as cause, so a boss UUID need not produce a nonnull cause entity despite preserved metadata. Entity overload supplies actual entity. removePredicateEffect snapshots active effects, applies holder predicate, computes level=amplifier+1, checks isOutOfEnergy(apCost*level,mpCost*level), then removes holder and reports any success. Its third double argument is MAGICULE COST, not removal level. NEB passes0; no assumption bypasses native event/energy admission.

energy_drain_and_conditional_normal_gain.actual_contract: EnergyHelper drain rejects nonpositive amount and source drain immunity, applies Energy Protection multiplier1-protection*0.1F, wraps amount/percentage/drain/gain in ManasCore Changeable and invokes ENERGY_DRAIN_EVENT. Unless EventResult.isFalse, actual drain branches require appropriate max attribute and use min(current/request) for current MAGICULE/AURA. EP can drain both independently. Marks storage dirty and hurt; remaining EP<=0 while alive forces health0, absorption0 and die(ENERGY_DRAIN), then returns true. A true return need not mean a positive amount drained. gain NORMAL respects effective max and spiritual limit only when prior current<=max; prior current>max uses unbounded new value. NORMAL_EXCEED_MAX always adds; MAX raises max attribute base and fills with cap. NEB rewrite NORMAL_EXCEED_MAX to NORMAL therefore does not universally clamp an already over-cap Luminous. Callback aggregation, Changeable and concrete storage still require the installed library.

lust_embracement_effect_boundary.actual_contract: Neutral LustEmbracement template uses interaction/block range, movement/flying/jump -1 ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL and knockback resistance+1 ADD_VALUE. On start stores locked rotations and marks effect storage dirty. Each positive-duration tick locks rotation; every20 effect-duration ticks, source==target returns whether an alive embraced entity exists in its interaction-range AABB. For a separate living source, sets ignorePainNull; amplifier>=1 requests percentage EP drain using configured embraceEPMastered, then fixed EP drain using embraceEP, both NORMAL_EXCEED_MAX; failed drain returns true. Dead source returns false. Attribute removal clears ignorePainNull and marks dirty. Exact callback dispatch, config defaults/overrides, rotation consumer and transitive skill behavior remain open.
